reuse.why: Changes only the existing isOffDay predicate (exported as isWeekendOrHoliday), which every holiday-aware path in shared/schedules.ts and server/schedules/app.ts already uses.

duplication.why: The MM-DD rule is a small isHoliday helper called from the single off-day predicate; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the off-day logic it extends.

scope.why: One helper, one test and a release note following the repo's upcoming-release-notes convention.

maintainability.why: Tiny, documented change at the single point where holidays are matched.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isOffDay/isWeekendOrHoliday.
